sloka: तृणवद्भाषितं तासां गणयामास जानकी ।गर्जितं च तदा तासां सीतां प्राप्य निरर्थकम् ।। ५.५८.८० ।।।।
transliteration: tṛṇavadbhāṣitaṁ tāsāṁ gaṇayāmāsa jānakī ।garjitaṁ ca tadā tāsāṁ sītāṁ prāpya nirarthakam ।। 5.58.80 ।।।।

translations.english: "Janaki did not care for their words of threat, as though they were a blade of grass and of no use to her.
